name: chains_flight
notes: An open iron manacle leading ~1 m of heavy chain (magistrate's own link size and iron palette) skipping along the floor: the cuff hops up to ~0.3 m and slams down (orange scrape sparks on the contact frames), a slither wave runs back down the chain, links rattle, grit and low dust kicked up behind. Anchor = the ground point under the manacle (feet). Low enough to jump.
